title: Edge: splitting a work order and merging assets keep services and history right
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View work orders, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A work order carries an asset that is enrolled on a schedule (or carries a compliance record), with at least one service due soon, due today or overdue, e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12', service 'PM-A'.
  3. Open that work order and find the maintenance panel inside the asset card.
custom_steps:
1. Split a work order that carries maintenance services and confirm each service stays with the work order that carries its lines (a marked-complete service stays with the original).
  2. Merge two assets and confirm enrolments, readings, certificates and history move to the asset that remains, keeping the later-completion enrolment where both were on the same schedule.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Splitting a work order keeps each service with the work order that carries its lines; a service marked complete stays with the original.
  • Merging two assets moves their enrolments, readings, certificates and history to the asset that remains; where both were on the same schedule, the enrolment with the later completion stays.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
